da-non-sequitur.referee_argument: Reduction 1 (md:14-15,42-46) claims the chirality average ⟨c⟩_β 'becomes a sum over integer crystal multiplicities'. But ⟨c⟩_β is SIGN-BEARING — the block itself writes c(λ)+c(λ^T)=0 (md:57). A Σ over crystal/KL multiplicities cannot supply a mixed-sign quantity: KL multiplicities are non-negative (KL positivity, a PROVED invariant), so the sign must come from χ^λ, not the multiplicity sum — the same wall that pruned PROBE-4.
da-non-sequitur.rebuttal: partial — cited proved invariant: KL-positivity vs mixed-sign Δ_λ (2026-06-16-option-e-probe4-kl-positivity-prune.md; Lean-proved PartitionOf5.deltaSign_mixed). The block partly hedges by routing the non-trivial part through χ^λ(β) imbalance (md:58-61) — where the sign legitimately could live — so not a clean non-sequitur, but the headline 'sum over integer crystal multiplicities' (md:15) is the pruned re-pitch and is overstated.

da-empirical-fragility.referee_argument: the crystal-bases substitution this prop leans on (crystal-bases-path-a.md, q→0 Kashiwara limit) is documented to DROP sub-leading information: the A=1 neutron pole-shift comes out 19 not the closed-form 22 (crystal-bases-path-a.md:99-132). The block claims these become 'finite combinatorial computations … substantially more tractable' (md:155-157) without flagging the crystal limit is leading-order-lossy for exactly the sub-leading amplitudes (α_5, chirality imbalance) it must compute.
da-empirical-fragility.rebuttal: partial — fragility documented in a sibling, but limited-scope: path-a is a SPEED optimisation for pole-ORDER (integer, leading-order suffices A≥2); this prop asks for sub-leading AMPLITUDES, where the same doc's A=1 anomaly shows the leading crystal asymptotic fails. A caution on transferability, not a disproof.

da-referee-verdict.referee_argument: The block ships a tactic-position `sorry` (lean:11) under an authorNotes label reading 'sorry-free conditional' (ts:36-37) — a flat, corpus-confirmed contradiction (buckets.json:230-237). NOT the false-positive pattern of the prior C1 blocks: the sorry is tactic-position (not a comment), the label verbatim describes this Lean, and §0a sibling-first finds no library decl to shadow. Beneath the label the Lean is structurally vacuous — `class … reduction_holds : Prop` is a §3b-cond rule-5 self-assuming projection encoding none of the three reductions, so the .md content is not derived even modulo the conjectures. The title 'resolves open problems' overclaims vs both the block's hedged body and the corpus (uniform research-grade stub); and Reduction-1's 'chirality = sum over integer crystal multiplicities' re-treads the KL-positivity-pruned PROBE-4 (mixed-sign cannot come from non-negative multiplicities). The conditionality hedges make the overclaim survivable-partial; the false 'sorry-free' label and the self-assuming class are flatly surviving.
